targetBenefit: Releases phytate-bound phosphorus and phytate-bound minerals in grains, reducing need for inorganic dicalcium phosphate.
notes: Heat-sensitive. Add post-pelleting or into cold dry/wet mash mixes.

targetBenefit: Thiamine analog that blocks Eimeria schizont development to prevent coccidiosis in young brooders.
notes: Do not co-administer with high-dose Vitamin B1 (Thiamine) supplements as it counteracts the mechanism.

targetBenefit: Competitive exclusion of Salmonella and E. coli; supports gut villi integrity and nutrient absorption.
notes: Store in cool, dark location. Best incorporated in dry feeds or freshly mixed wet mashes.

targetBenefit: Slow-release calcium source for nocturnal eggshell calcification in mature laying hens and waterfowl.
notes: Large particle size (>2mm) ensures retention in the gizzard overnight.

targetBenefit: Provides mechanical grinding action in the gizzard required for digesting whole or coarsely cracked grains.
notes: Does not solubilize or alter dietary mineral balances.

targetBenefit: Lowers gut pH, inhibiting pathogenic bacterial growth and suppressing feed mold/fungal spores.
notes: Improves protein digestibility by activating pepsinogen in the proventriculus.
